text: I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting with shortness of breath, increased abdominal girth, and a large ovarian mass. To begin our evaluation, have you experienced any unintentional weight loss or changes in your bowel habits recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 40-year-old nulliparous woman. The patient reports experiencing shortness of breath and noticeable increase in abdominal size over the past month. She denies any significant medical history, previous surgeries, or use of medications.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Ovarian Carcinoma.

The clinical picture of a large ovarian mass, shortness of breath, and increased abdominal girth in a 40-year-old woman is highly suggestive of ovarian cancer. Given the potential for malignant ascites and pleural effusion causing these symptoms, I will request immediate imaging to confirm the diagnosis and stage the disease. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Pelvic_CT_and_Chest_X-Ray.
